evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette and glass-box tank, but garden and journal screens feel plainer than the tank.
evidence.C2: Labelled tools like Feed, Care, Scape are findable, but phone fishing fight shows bottom nav overlapping text.
evidence.C3: Summary lists care, fishing, breeding, scaping, greenhouse, reef genetics, orders, journal, and focus loops.
evidence.C4: Consistent cards and pills, but an unlabeled empty button appears beside Phone motion and some toasts crowd the edge.

fixes: Fix phone safe-area and scroll padding so bottom nav never covers fishing or care text and controls.
Raise visual distinctiveness by enlarging and detailing fish/tank art and giving garden and journal the same field-guide treatment.
Make interlocking loops visible with next-step cues, such as trim to cuttings to order, fishing quest progress, and label or remove the empty fishing control.

evidence.C1: Tank art is genuinely distinctive with perspective side panes, receding gravel floor, depth haze, fish floor shadows, lid rim and stand; warm cream palette with green accents is coherent; fishing scene has nice atmospheric depth (moon, haze, ridge); journal silhouettes have field-guide charm. Garden trays feel notably emptier/less designed than other screens.
evidence.C2: Strong onboarding: 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.' hint, 'More to do' card with three clear next steps, well-labeled tools row (Feed, Care, Scape, Residents, Shop, Photo, Watch, Share). Phone layout wraps tools to 2x4 grid cleanly. Fishing instructions ('Flick up on the water to cast') and tension/drag controls are explicit.
evidence.C3: Explicitly lists care (nitrogen cycle sim), fishing minigame (flick cast, strike, reel tension, drag, 5 baits, 5 lures, tournaments, 12 quests, 47 species, 5 rarities), breeding with inherited colours, aquascaping (16 plants, 8 hardscape, 3 substrates, 3 tank sizes, reef room), greenhouse (cuttings, variegated sports), reef lab (frag, cross, named strains), journal (dex, milestones), focus timer, offline catch-up. Matches the rubric's 10-description almost verbatim.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating nav, card shadows and spacing across desktop and phone views. Feedback messages like 'It is running. Let it take line' are unobtrusive and well placed. Minor: phone fishing view shows bottom nav overlapping the 'Weather changes every three hours' caption; garden tray cards are visually sparse compared to other screens.

fixes: Increase visual density and designed feel of the Garden screen — trays look empty next to the richly detailed tank and fishing scenes; add tray illustrations, growth stages, or a small scene preview per tray.

Resolve phone fishing overlap where the bottom nav covers the weather/dawn caption ('Weather changes every three hours. Dawn and dusk...') — add bottom padding to the scroll area or dock the nav above content.

Push the visual identity further toward a 'field-guide' look — add subtle paper-grain or botanical-illustration touches (e.g., specimen labels, hand-drawn dividers, Latin names) to the Journal and Care screens to match the tank art's hero quality.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette with serif display type; tank rendered with 'perspective side panes, receding gravel floor, depth haze, fish floor shadows' and moonlit fishing scene. Falls short of 'every screen feels designed': Garden desktop leaves a large empty cream area below the four trays, and fish art stays very simple.
evidence.C2: Strong next-step cues: 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.', 'Flick up on the water to cast', 'Pick a length and start when you are ready.', 'Plant a seedling to start growing.' Controls grouped and labelled on phone. Ding: the empty unlabelled pill beside 'Phone motion' in fishing Controls is ambiguous.
evidence.C3: All anchor loops present and interlocked: nitrogen-cycle care, flick/reel fishing with '9 spots... tournaments... 47 species, 5 rarities', breeding with inherited colours, scaping, greenhouse, reef lab strains, daily orders, journal, focus. Linkage shown ('Trimming gives cuttings to replant, sell or deliver'); orders loop only surfaces as a side-column mention, so not a full 10.
evidence.C4: Consistent pills, cards and toasts ('My first tank is ready', 'Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more') with matching amber accent. Rough edges: unlabelled empty toggle next to 'Phone motion', and the fishing Cast button stretches nearly full-width unlike every other button.

fixes: Redesign the Garden desktop layout: trays end mid-page leaving a large dead area — bring in inventory, orders or a reef-lab preview so the screen feels composed (biggest C1 gain at w=0.30).
Label or properly style the empty pill beside 'Phone motion' in the fishing Controls card — it reads as a broken control and costs both C2 and C4.
Normalise primary-button sizing (full-width Cast vs pill buttons elsewhere) and verify toasts never sit under the header/theme controls on desktop.
